name: Bearded youth
description: A bearded young widower marked by mourning whose lekythos libation draws the Weeping Woman and her children.

timeline.summary: At the salt marsh the priests chant while the young widower pours the lekythos into the water, drawing the Weeping Woman and children from the mist.
timeline.quote: Then, out of the mists, she came.

timeline.summary: Misty child spirits play through the agora at dawn and vanish into the walls, and Perisophia declares the children at rest.
